row.title: Connect links must survive sign-in
row.body: A signed-out visit to /connect/bluesky was sent to /auth/signin?next=/connections, and the emailed-code and GitHub sign-ins dropped next, so the owner always landed on the dashboard and never reached the Bluesky consent. next is now the page that asked, carried through passkey, emailed-code and GitHub sign-in, limited to /connect/<provider> and /connections.
